title: UneceSpatialDimension
description: A measure of spatial extent of an object, such as the length, breadth or height of a shipping container.

componentSpatialDimension.description: A dimension that is a component of this spatial dimension.

description.description: A textual description of this spatial dimension.

dimensionTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of spatial dimension, such as thickness, area, or volume.

heightMeasure.description: The measure of the height component of this spatial dimension.

identifier.description: The unique identifier of this spatial dimension.

lengthMeasure.description: The measure of the length component of this spatial dimension.

linearUnitDiameterMeasure.description: The measure of the diameter component for this spatial dimension.

linearUnitHeightMeasure.description: The measure of the height component of this spatial dimension.

linearUnitLengthMeasure.description: The measure of the length component of this spatial dimension.

linearUnitWidthMeasure.description: The measure of the width component of this spatial dimension.

unitQuantity.description: The number of units with these spatial dimensions.

unitValueMeasure.description: The measure of the value of this spatial dimension.

widthMeasure.description: The measure of the width component of this spatial dimension.
